findings.finding: AipEvalRunner starts from suite_id and suite_revision and never consumes an exact EvalContractRevision, so the task-level severity, gate, return and override contract is not the execution authority.

EvalContract readiness checks only the originally bound published event row. Revocation appends a second event and does not mutate the bound row, so a revoked publication can still leave the frozen EvalContract reporting ready.

ImpactPreview revalidation compares the EvalContract row revision, hash and lifecycle only; it does not re-evaluate the contract's publication and release-gate dependencies, so the canonical start path cannot currently fail closed on this transitive drift.
Revision history is addressable, but there is no server-owned EvalContract diff contract or Workshop-ready Diff view.
There is no command that accepts an exact EvalContractRevision and proves that a returned EvalRun and EvalReport used that same contract version.
ReleaseGateDecision stores invalidated_by, but no invalidation command or lifecycle transition was found; current gate derivation is append-only passed or failed.

decisions: retain AIP EvalContractRevision, EvalSuiteRevision, EvalRun, EvalReport, ReleaseGateDecision and PublicationEvent as the only authorities; Workshop must not create a parallel eval store
add an AIP command that starts evaluation from an exact frozen EvalContractRevision and emits contract_ref on EvalRun and EvalReport lineage
resolve publication state by publication_id latest effective event, not by checking only the bound published event row
make frozen ImpactPreview revalidation recurse through EvalContract dynamic dependencies or consume a server-owned dependency-state hash that changes on revocation or invalidation
provide a server-owned semantic EvalContract diff over suite, thresholds, gate policy, return mapping, override policy, publication and release gate refs
a changed standard creates a new EvalContract revision; same-version rerun must preserve the exact contract ref and never silently select the latest suite or policy
do not implement Workshop Eval UI beyond read-only blocked-state consumption until these P0 boundaries and W3 exit are closed

verification.broadResult: 20 passed, 1 failed; the failure was an unrelated responsibility-plan list count polluted by pre-existing synthetic test rows
verification.interpretation: existing direct authority behavior is stable; the missing exact run binding, semantic diff and transitive invalidation are uncovered requirements, not regressions claimed by the current tests

fixedUpstreamSnapshot.note: read-only m1 snapshot; active AIP W2-D3 files were not modified

nextGate: AIP must close exact EvalContract-to-EvalRun lineage and transitive publication or release-gate invalidation before Workshop W4-03 implementation can be authorized.
